changes.defect: Windows PowerShell 5.1 emits a JSON array from ConvertFrom-Json as a single pipeline object. Wrapping that pipeline in @() produced a nested array, so the subprocess argument-count assertion failed with 'Argument count changed.'
changes.fix: Assign the JSON result first, then normalize to an array only when it is not already one.
changes.verification: RUNNER_TEST_PASS in PowerShell 7.6.9 and Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9444; exit code 0 for both.

changes.defect: The same 5.1 array semantics turned a one-entry vswhere result into a nested array, so installationPath/installationVersion could not be read as scalars.
changes.fix: Normalize the ConvertFrom-Json result after assignment, before the count check and the generator-selection loop.
changes.verification: Windows PowerShell 5.1 run with a temporary fake cmake that advertises 'Visual Studio 18 2026' selected the real vswhere installation and printed Generator: Visual Studio 18 2026; VS: 18.10.12224.181; exit code 0. No real CMake or Windows SDK is installed on this host.

changes.defect: The first GitHub Actions run (41469600981) found several python.exe Application commands on windows-2025. Reading .Source from the collection produced one space-joined string, which configure_windows passed as Python3_EXECUTABLE; CMake then failed with 'Cannot run the interpreter'.
changes.fix: Select the first Application command before reading .Source in all four scripts.
changes.verification: The defect was reproduced by CI run 41469600981. Local PowerShell 7 and 5.1 runner gates pass after the change; a repeated Windows CI run is the native verification.

changes.defect: The real PresentMon 2.6.0 binary writes --help to stderr. The runner only checked presentmon.help.txt on stdout and aborted with 'PresentMon help missing --process_name' before starting the app.
changes.fix: Concatenate stdout and stderr help files before checking the required flags in both the normal runner and the elevated observer path.
changes.verification: Real PresentMon 2.6.0 --help produced 86 lines on stderr with all nine runner flags. The fixed runner advanced past the help gate; the later elevated-observer runs produced valid traces.

changes.defect: PresentMon 2.6.0 --v2_metrics writes the CPU-busy column as CPUBusy. The classifier required MsCPUBusy and returned UNVERIFIED_SCHEMA on a valid real trace.
changes.fix: Accept either CPUBusy or MsCPUBusy as the same millisecond metric; fail with UNVERIFIED_SCHEMA only when both are absent. Added alias and missing-column regression tests.
changes.verification: The real control trace then classified as PASS / CONTROL_VERIFIED_NOT_FSE with exit 0; the real legacy trace classified as FAIL_NOT_CLASSIC_EXCLUSIVE. All 99 Python tests pass.
